channel.title: Scout Daily — AI Intelligence Feed
channel.description: Daily AI case studies and industry news for IT engineers and AI consultants.

item.title: [News] The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned amid scandal involving alleged personal misconduct and potential national security concerns. The controversy raises questions about Nvidia’s role in AI chip supply and U.S. export controls that could affect global AI infrastructure.

item.title: [News] Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: Google DeepMind has launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster, cost‑efficient model for everyday coding and agentic workflows, and introduced Orchestrator to switch between models automatically. This update promises significant speedups and lower token costs for developers using the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, and related enterprise tools.

item.title: [News] Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending
item.description: Nebius, a neocloud provider, announced a $40 billion spend plan for 2027 but faces significant construction delays, especially at a Microsoft‑contracted New Jersey site. The setbacks risk financial penalties and could impact the reliability of cloud services for large customers.

item.title: [News] JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
item.description: JioStar has deployed a conversational video and cricket-stat discovery assistant on its JioHotstar platform using the OpenAI API, enabling voice‑visual search across 15 languages for 500 million users. The solution balances accuracy, latency, and cost to deliver real‑time recommendations and statistics to millions of concurrent viewers.

item.title: [News] BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
item.description: Hugging Face’s BotPsy is a 0.8B‑parameter agentic language model optimized for on‑device deployment, excelling in tool‑use and instruction following while keeping user data private. Its low cost and high performance make it attractive for privacy‑conscious, low‑to‑medium task automation in enterprise workflows.
